reviewer: OMP agent (M14 GitHub channels and authorized publication)
note: GH-010 reject unauthorized publication: publication requires an explicit grant, and src/channels/publication.zig checks it before the plan is even validated, so an unauthorized request is refused without the operation having looked at the plan and there is no state in which a partial publication exists because authorization arrived after work began. The plan carries all_tests_passed deliberately: a green build is exactly the state an agent is in when it is tempted to publish itself, and the test asserts the refusal in that state rather than in a contrived one. A grant names the channel it covers and the moment it expires, so a grant for another channel and an expired grant are distinct refusals rather than a generic denial, and the boundary is inclusive - at the expiry second the grant is over. The test also checks that all of those refusals left the effect counters exactly where they were. Fault proof: silently filling in a missing grant makes publication proceed unauthorized and the refusal assertion fails (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
